response.sql: WITH scan_data AS (SELECT s.zoneref, st.healtheval, CASE WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin != 0 THEN s.gbsize / s.spanmin ELSE NULL END AS ratio_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'), group_stats AS (SELECT zoneref, healtheval, AVG(ratio_per_min) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scan_data WHERE ratio_per_min IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref, healtheval), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg_ratio FROM group_stats), filtered_groups AS (SELECT gs.zoneref, gs.healtheval, gs.avg_ratio, gs.scan_count, gs.avg_ratio - om.mean_avg_ratio AS exceeds_mean FROM group_stats gs CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE om.mean_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND gs.avg_ratio > om.mean_avg_ratio) SELECT zoneref, healtheval, avg_ratio, scan_count, exceeds_mean FROM filtered_groups ORDER BY exceeds_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
